description: Pet appearance picker on the registration form
replace:
$0

<xf:if is="$sylUserPetsAppearances is not empty">
	<xf:formrow label="{{ phrase('sylphian_userpets_pet_appearance') }}"
		hint="{{ phrase('required') }}"
		explain="{{ phrase('sylphian_userpets_pet_appearance_register_explain') }}">
		<xf:macro id="sylphian_userpets_macros::appearance_picker"
			arg-name="sylphian_userpets_spritesheet"
			arg-choices="{$sylUserPetsAppearances}"
			arg-required="{{ true }}" />
	</xf:formrow>
</xf:if>
